name: Product Photo AI for WooCommerce
author: Denis Golovin

sections.description:
Product Photo AI for WooCommerce is a powerful extension that automatically generates professional product shots for your WooCommerce products using artificial intelligence. Transform your product photography with AI-generated backgrounds, lighting, and compositions to boost your store’s visual appeal and conversion rates.

Features:
* AI-powered product shot generation
* Multiple background options and styles
* Seamless WooCommerce integration
* Professional quality results
* Easy-to-use interface

To get started you need to create a free or paid account at product-photo-ai.com. See the Installation section for more details.

Development

This plugin is open source! Contribute to the development or report issues on GitHub: https://github.com/codeneric/product-photo-ai-for-woocommerce
sections.installation:
1. Visit Plugins > Add New
  2. Search for “Product Photo AI for WooCommerce”
  3. Install and Activate Product Photo AI for WooCommerce from your Plugins page
  4. Visit https://product-photo-ai.com to sign up for a free trial or paid plan.
  5. Link your account by copying your API key into the Product Photo AI for WooCommerce plugin settings page.
  6. Upload an image to have product images generated automatically!
  7. Select the generated images as usual from the media library.

short_description: Generates beautiful product photos based on a single image.
